svg.title: Tuck return
svg.desc: Numbered body-frame maps label the commanded six foot targets and which tripod is lifted. The notes and phase data contain the programmed values.
svg.text: Body-fixed top view · nose is up · small gray rings mark displaced starting targets
Teal: tripod A (1, 3, 5) · Amber: tripod B (2, 4, 6) · Ring: lifted · Filled: planted
